title: Answer: no account of life, which enters only as the organism the workspace serves

statements.text: The global workspace theory takes no position on what life is. The organism enters only in the theory's account of why consciousness evolved: a workspace lets an organism rely on mental simulation and internal evaluation before acting, which lowers its risks and its spending of energy, and frees it from its immediate environment.
statements.scope: the 2001 workspace framework of Dehaene and Naccache, section 6.4 on the evolution of consciousness

sources.quote: The more an organism can rely on mental simulation and internal evaluation to select a course of action, instead of acting out in the open world, the lower are the risks and the expenditure of energy.
whose main advantage is the freeing of the organism from its immediate environment.
